method.zhHans: 他改动了扶手，使其被削弱、一碰就断，然后把 Numao 诱到那里。他打电话过去，骗 Numao 以为警察在追他；Numao 看见一名警察朝自己走来，便跑上消防梯，从那处被动过手脚的护栏摔了下去。未遂谋杀 档案：EP707 Case2.jpg 地点：旧楼 受害者：毛利兰与毛利小五郎 年龄：17 岁与 37-38 岁 伤势：刺伤与殴打 凶手：Reiji Himuro 身份被揭穿为凶手后，他企图杀死毛利小五郎，被毛利兰拦下并由毛利小五郎制服。
method.en: He had tampered with the handrail so that it was weakened and would break, and lured Numao there. Calling him on the phone, he tricked him into thinking the police were after him and after seeing a cop walk up to him he ran up the fire escape and fell through the tampered railing. Attempted Murder File:EP707 Case2.jpg Location: Old building Victim: Ran Mouri and Kogoro Mouri Age: 17 years old and 37-38 years old injury: Stab wound and Assault Culprit: Reiji Himuro After being exposed as the culprit, he attempted to kill Kogoro was intercepted by Ran and subdued by Kogoro.

evidence.en: Faced with all the evidence and being proven guilty, Himuro draws a knife and attacks Kogoro, but is intercepted by Ran.

resolution.zhHans: 这是一起谋杀案。凶手是 Reiji Himuro。他改动了扶手，使其被削弱、一碰就断，然后把 Numao 诱到那里。他打电话过去，骗 Numao 以为警察在追他；Numao 看见一名警察朝自己走来，便跑上消防梯，从那处被动过手脚的护栏摔了下去。那通电话的一部分被一台开着的录音机录下，揭露了 Himuro 用虚假信息设局陷害 Numao、致使他惊慌失措坠楼身亡。面对所有证据、被证明有罪后，Himuro 拔刀袭击毛利小五郎，却被毛利兰拦下。
resolution.en: This case is murder. The culprit is Reiji Himuro. He had tampered with the handrail so that it was weakened and would break, and lured Numao there. Calling him on the phone, he tricked him into thinking the police were after him and after seeing a cop walk up to him he ran up the fire escape and fell through the tampered railing. Part of the phone call was captured by an open radio recording revealing Himuro setting up Numao by giving him false information causing him to panic and fall to his death. Faced with all the evidence and being proven guilty, Himuro draws a knife and attacks Kogoro, but is intercepted by Ran.

l3Absent.reason: 原文未给出 Himuro 杀害 Numao 的动机

summary.en: While having a snack in a roadside café, Kogoro is called by Reiji Himuro, who seems envious of Kogoro's nice life and then says that at that moment, someone was to die because of Kogoro. At that time, Shingo Numao falls off a building, watched by a police officer who had been called there by an anonymous call.
